criterion.description: A synthesized gesture passes only when held-out repetition recall is at least 80% and nearest-rival Fisher separation exceeds its one-to-one matched catalogue gesture.

teach_back_definition: A simulated reward-driven learner starts at rest and adjusts its synergy command from Cartograph feedback alone (where each attempt landed, and its distance to the target). Learned: at least 3 of the last 5 attempts land nearer the target than any other vocabulary target. Retention: held-out decoder recall when the learned commands are performed as a vocabulary, against recall of the exact targets.
caveat: Simulated babble and simulated users. Fatigue accrual is a simulator assumption proportional to excitation, so the fatigue term largely duplicates effort here. Teach-back uses a simulated learner whose command space is the same synergy set babble was generated from, so every target is reachable by construction; whether people can learn these targets is untested. Not a human result.
